name: I, Robot CPU PCB
notes: This board was published as one map that was really two. i-robot-video is the other half. The manual documents a CPU PCB and a Video PCB in one IC parts list, and their designators do not overlap — so nothing collided, nothing warned, and the merged map looked complete. Cell 5A on one is not cell 5A on the other, which makes a merged map actively misleading rather than merely incomplete. Found by asking, for every published board, whether its trusted rows sat under more than one figure heading naming a different PCB.
Only one printing is in the corpus, so nothing here is cross-checked against a second source.
Column-first designators, recorded in grid.transposed rather than inferred.
No component-location drawing has been read. The grid spacing is nominal.
